issues.on_page: Local 73,347 (Road Fund budget schedule); p4 prints the Road Fund breakdown: Local 35,284 + Sale of surplus 38,063
issues.issue: 38,063 of the 73,347 (51.9%) is sale of surplus per the p4 Road Fund column, so the dominant category is Sale of Property (or split with split_from from p4); charges for services/fees does not fit the larger part. The sale of surplus is also other financing on p4, not revenue.
